family.assembly_instances.shared_construction_foundation: The repeated nested assembly baseline is paired with source-bound AP242 mapped-item transformations and an audited external reference, explicitly separating source transform, imported rigid TopLoc_Location, and geometry-baked conversion.
family.assembly_instances.title: Rigid and non-rigid assembly instances

family.curve_taxonomy.shared_construction_foundation: A shared free-wire and face-bound edge factory that derives exact parameters, wrapper stacks, periodic and closed distinctions, and continuity evidence before checking the unprocessed post-STEP representation.
family.curve_taxonomy.title: Curve taxonomy, wrappers, and continuity

family.edge_representation.shared_construction_foundation: Exact seam, pole, and micro-edge baselines plus source-bound deterministic mutations; every edge use binds the 3D curve, each face p-curve, both ranges, endpoints, tolerance, flags, and measured S(C_uv(t)) discrepancy.
family.edge_representation.title: Edge, p-curve, and parameter representation

family.external_corpus.shared_construction_foundation: Immutable externally authored STEP assets with application/version/export records, file-verified schema, ownership or licence evidence, content hashes, and independent post-XDE oracles.
family.external_corpus.title: Audited external authoring and schema corpus

family.import_failures.shared_construction_foundation: Small valid STEP/XDE baselines with deterministic syntax, product, and entity-reference mutations whose expected result is a named translator failure retaining source entity and diagnostic provenance.
family.import_failures.title: STEP import and translator failure artifacts

family.native_faults.shared_construction_foundation: Registered deterministic native producers use the same public evaluator and typed Result boundary as production to inject unknown dynamic types, evaluation failures, undefined normals, NaN, and infinity.
family.native_faults.title: Native evaluator and unknown-type fault injection

family.numeric_pathology.shared_construction_foundation: Shared valid baselines at controlled units and scales plus deterministic source-bound mutations for duplicate, gap, area, orientation, and self-intersection failures, all with exact thresholds and no healing.
family.numeric_pathology.title: Numerical and topological pathology matrix

family.reconnaissance_consumers.shared_construction_foundation: Consumer suites run the complete cross-lane corpus through the production importer, inventory, classifier, deterministic report, fail-closed unknown path, and Qt diagnostic palette; these suite IDs are aggregations, not substitutes for source fixtures.
family.reconnaissance_consumers.title: M2/M3 reconnaissance consumers

family.semantic_blends.shared_construction_foundation: A shared support-solid and edge-network matrix varying radius law, blend participants, raw face splits, junction degree, chamfer width, and termination support while preserving exact feature provenance.
family.semantic_blends.title: Blend, fillet, chamfer, and termination semantics

family.semantic_primitives.shared_construction_foundation: Parametric feature towers with independent analytic or construction derivations for supporting faces, boundaries, fitted parameters, residuals, and explicit candidate confidence without relying on the future recognizer.
family.semantic_primitives.title: Primitive, freeform, and feature semantics

family.support_decisions.shared_construction_foundation: A mixed-component decision matrix reuses exact analytic, structured, cut-graph, residual, ambiguous, invalid, and unknown subjects so assignment totality, confidence evidence, preview status, and component gate outcome can be checked independently.
family.support_decisions.title: Support, confidence, and fail-closed gate decisions

family.surface_freeform_wrappers.shared_construction_foundation: A four-sided patch and adjacent-patch factory sharing exact poles, weights, knots, generators, wrapper ancestry, UV metric samples, and cross-face continuity measurements.
family.surface_freeform_wrappers.title: Freeform surfaces, wrappers, and continuity

family.surface_periodic_singular.shared_construction_foundation: One analytic-surface recipe matrix varying full and partial domains, shifted seams, face reversal, cap and pole contact, and regular versus degenerate parameters with exact period and singularity derivations.
family.surface_periodic_singular.title: Analytic periodic and singular surfaces

family.topology_hierarchy.shared_construction_foundation: Low-level BRep_Builder and XDE constructions sharing exact partner identity, explicit incidence, orientation, shell role, and ordered occurrence descriptors across one processing-disabled STEP readback path.
family.topology_hierarchy.title: Topology hierarchy and model incidence

family.trim_faults.shared_construction_foundation: The valid trim-domain baselines are mutated by registered source-bound recipes that alter only loop closure, ordering, nesting, or intersection while preserving the baseline geometry and provenance.
family.trim_faults.title: Invalid and ambiguous trim mutations

family.trim_valid_domains.shared_construction_foundation: A loop builder shared across planar, periodic, singular, and freeform supports, retaining ordered coedges, nesting, per-loop UV bounds, seam unwrap, and one-to-many retained-domain identity.
family.trim_valid_domains.title: Valid trim-domain classes
